mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In supply constraint regimes (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), manufacturing output stagnation increases inflation risks and prompts monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, triggering aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Robust labor market growth (PAYEMS monthly change > 100k) sustains consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when PAYEMS monthly change exceeds 100k.

mechanism_narrative: In strong demand expansion regimes (GDPC1 annualized quarterly growth > 2.0%), robust consumer and business spending drives corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when GDPC1 annualized quarterly growth exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals supply shock, increasing uncertainty and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month.
